proposal.summary: The message reports an unsubstantiated, non-technical claim that the company's servers 'might be vulnerable' based on hearsay; no technical details, evidence, or tested exploit are provided.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request concrete technical details from the reporter (vulnerable product, versions, proof-of-concept or logs) or perform an internal review/scanning of externally exposed services relevant to recent publicized attacks.

evidence_quotes.claim: Report contains only hearsay and no technical details
evidence_quotes.quote: I do not have technical details and I have not tested anything myself
your company's servers might be vulnerable to the new attacks that are in the news this month

evidence_quotes.claim: Reporter is notifying out of caution
evidence_quotes.quote: I wanted to let you know in case it is important so you can check your systems before something happens.
